main.description: Get the recent deploy history for a repository, newest first. Authenticated with the caller's serviceauth token (audience = the sites worker's DID); only the repository owner may read it.

repoDid.description: DID of the repository as minted by the knot.

deploys.description: The 20 most recent deploys, newest first. Empty when the repository has never deployed.

errors.name: NotOwner
errors.description: The account does not own this repository.

errors.name: RepoNotFound
errors.description: No repository record publishes this repo DID.

errors.name: OwnershipUnverifiable
errors.description: Repository ownership could not be verified.

errors.name: SiteNotFound
errors.description: The repository has no site configuration or the owner has no active claim.

trigger.description: What asked for the deploy: a site config change, a push to the deployed branch, or a manual redeploy.

dir.description: Directory within the repository the deploy built (e.g. '/' or '/docs').

commitSha.description: Commit the deploy built. Empty for a config-change deploy, which builds the branch tip at deploy time.

error.description: Why the deploy failed. Empty when it succeeded.
